title: Kenya eTIMS Rollout Timeline 2021-2027
description: The phases of Kenya's electronic Tax Invoice Management System: announcement, rollout, enforcement, the January 2026 return-validation switch, Finance Act 2026 penalty minimums, and the planned CETIS pre-clearance system.
attribution: SmartVAT Kenya (smartvatkenya.co.ke), compiled from KRA public notices, the Tax Procedures Act (Cap. 469) as amended, and Finance Act 2026.

records.event: KRA announces eTIMS as the successor to the Tax Invoice Management System (TIMS)
records.detail: eTIMS broadens electronic invoicing beyond ESC-registered devices to web portal, mobile and paypoint variants.

records.event: Nationwide onboarding of VAT-registered taxpayers starts
records.detail: KRA begins mass onboarding through iTax integration, OSCU/VSCU devices, the online portal and the eTIMS mobile app.

records.event: Onboarding deadline for VAT-registered taxpayers; enforcement follows from September 2023
records.detail: The Tax Procedures (Amendment) Act 2023 inserted s.59A into the TPA, making electronic invoicing a statutory duty.

records.event: Online-portal and mobile eTIMS extended to non-VAT taxpayers for income tax expense substantiation
records.detail: Businesses below the VAT threshold begin using eTIMS receipts to support deductible expenses.

records.event: KRA validates VAT returns against eTIMS invoice data
records.detail: The eTIMS ledger effectively becomes the draft return: invoice-time errors surface at filing time.

records.event: Finance Act 2026 eTIMS penalty minimums take effect
records.detail: Electronic filing and payment non-compliance: higher of 5% of tax due, KES 100,000 (companies) or KES 10,000 (individuals) — replacing the prior 2x tax due rule.

records.event: Comprehensive Electronic Tax Invoicing System (pre-clearance) procurement and build
records.detail: CETIS validates and signs invoices before a transaction completes — the Uganda EFRIS model. Expected 2027-28.
